info.title: medicalcheckup.20fit.id API
info.description:
Public JSON API for medicalcheckup.20fit.id (20FIT's medical check-up awareness site). This service is otherwise a server-rendered site (educational pages, the health quizzes, the Scan MCU tool UI) — this spec documents only its JSON endpoints, not the HTML page routes.

**Sensitivity.** `POST /api/scan` handles real, member-linked medical check-up data (patient name, clinical notes) and is treated as highly sensitive: its response schema is intentionally not published here. `POST /api/quiz/submit` and `GET /api/quiz/history` handle self-reported health-quiz answers and are documented in full, but are still personal health data — treat responses accordingly.

**Auth.** Bearer tokens are Supabase access tokens issued by the member's session on my.20fit.id; this service does not issue or refresh tokens itself.

**Safety note.** The health quizzes (e.g. the BMI quiz) are understanding tools, not medical exams, and never return calorie or weight-loss targets. Some quiz outcomes deliberately withhold computed values (e.g. the BMI number) in favor of a calm, non-alarming suggestion to talk to a health professional — see the `computed` field description on `QuizSubmitResponse`.

tags.name: MCU Scan
tags.description: Member-only analysis of an uploaded medical check-up document. 🔴 Sensitive — real health-record data.

tags.name: Quizzes
tags.description: CMS-driven health awareness quizzes (BMI, runner, HYROX, etc). 🟡 Sensitive — self-reported health data.

tags.name: Articles
tags.description: Published health-education articles. 🟢 Public, same content already on /articles.

post.summary: Analyze an uploaded medical check-up document
post.description:
🔴 **Sensitive.** Members-only — an anonymous request is rejected before any file is read or analyzed (this service never processes anonymous health data). The uploaded document is forwarded server-side to 20FIT's internal analysis backend; no analysis key or credential is ever exposed to the browser.

The full response schema is intentionally not published in this document, since a successful result contains patient-identifying and clinical fields (patient name, doctor's notes, metrics). See `ScanSuccessResponse` below for the outer envelope only.

400.description: Bad request — invalid JSON body, missing file, unsupported file type, or the upstream analyzer could not read the document as an MCU report.

not_mcu.description: The uploaded document doesn't look like a medical check-up report.

incomplete_mcu.description: Recognized as an MCU report, but missing fields needed to analyze it.

401.description: Missing or invalid Bearer token — anonymous requests are always rejected here.

413.description: File too large (request body, or the decoded file, exceeds the ~10MB limit).

429.description: This member has exceeded the scan rate limit.

503.description: This service isn't configured/available right now (e.g. missing server credentials).

504.description: The upstream analysis backend timed out.

post.summary: Submit answers to a health quiz and get a result
post.description:
🟡 **Sensitive** (self-reported health data). Answerable anonymously by design — quiz results are shown in full to every visitor; only saving a history across devices requires signing in. Outcome matching (including safety-sensitive branches — e.g. the BMI quiz's "withhold the number, suggest a professional" path, or injury-history overriding a training suggestion) is evaluated **server-side only** and is driven by CMS content, so exact outcome keys/copy can change without a deploy.

Question `id`s are defined by each quiz's CMS content and are only exposed via this site's own server-rendered quiz pages (not a separate public JSON endpoint) — this operation is documented here for completeness and API audit purposes, not as a fully self-describing integration surface.

**External integration partners:** this is the only endpoint in this API that accepts a partner API key (`X-API-Key` header) as an alternative to a member Bearer token. It's optional and purely additive — omit it entirely for a normal anonymous or member submission. It exists only to identify which external integration is calling; it does NOT grant access to any other member's data (this endpoint never returns another person's results). `/api/scan` and `/api/quiz/history` do not accept it and never will, since those return one specific member's own health data.

200.description: A matching outcome was found and (if an identity was available) the result was saved.

400.description: Invalid request body or answers (missing required answer, out-of-range number, unknown option id, or neither a Bearer token nor an anonId was supplied).

401.description: An `X-API-Key` header was sent but is unknown, revoked, or malformed. Omit the header entirely for a normal anonymous/member request instead of sending an invalid one.

404.description: No active quiz with this slug.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded for this identity (member or anonymous id).

500.description: Content-configuration error: the quiz has no catch-all outcome configured in the CMS, so nothing matched. Not a client error.

503.description: This service isn't configured/available right now.

get.summary: List the authenticated member's past quiz results

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language for quiz/outcome titles in the response.

503.description: This service isn't configured/available right now.

get.summary: List the latest published health articles
get.description:
🟢 **Public, no auth.** A listing feed over the same published health-education content already visible on `/articles` — this exposes nothing that isn't already public. Never returns unpublished content, and never contains patient/health-record data (that's `/api/scan`, which is separate and much more restricted).

Not to be confused with `/api/articles` (a separate, Bearer-token-authenticated publish/management API — see that operation for create/update/delete). This one is deliberately at a different path: same path with two different auth models would be a security hazard, and this feed must never require a credential.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max number of articles to return.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language for the article's own-site URL (`url`) when the article doesn't have an external canonical URL.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter to one article category (matches the `category` field on the response).

200.description: OK. Always 200 — an unreachable content store degrades to an empty list, never an error.

supabaseBearerAuth.description: A Supabase access token for a signed-in 20FIT member, obtained by logging in on my.20fit.id. This service verifies the token server-side; it does not issue, refresh, or store credentials.

partnerApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
partnerApiKeyAuth.description: Optional, for external integration partners only, and only on POST /api/quiz/submit (see that operation's description for scope and why it's never accepted elsewhere). Issued out-of-band by 20FIT; only its SHA-256 hash is stored server-side. Send `X-API-Key: <PLACEHOLDER_KEY>`.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code — see each response's examples for the codes an endpoint can actually return.

file.description: The document as a base64 data: URL. Decoded size must be at most ~10MB.

ScanSuccessResponse.description: Envelope only — see the operation description for why `result`'s inner schema isn't published here.

result.description: The full MCU analysis result. Intentionally undocumented here — contains patient-identifying and clinical fields.

answers.description: Map of question id → answer value. Value type depends on the question's type: a number for "number" questions, an option id (string) for "single_choice", or an array of option ids for "multi_choice". Question ids/types come from the quiz's CMS content, rendered on this site's own quiz pages.

anonId.description: Client-generated id identifying an anonymous visitor across quizzes on this device, so results can later be claimed after signing in. Required when no Bearer token is present.

key.description: Stable outcome key, defined in the CMS.

advice.description: Localized advice text for the matched outcome. Never includes a calorie or weight-loss target.

resultId.description: Id of the saved result row, if it could be saved.

computed.description: Derived values the quiz needed to evaluate outcomes (e.g. `{ bmi, age }` for the BMI quiz). Some fields are deliberately withheld for safety: e.g. `bmi` is omitted here whenever the matched outcome is one of the BMI quiz's gentle-redirect branches, so a concerning pattern never surfaces a bare number — the `outcome.advice` text carries the message instead.

cover_image_url.description: Absolute URL, or null when the article has no photo (its page still shows a generated themed cover, which isn't a URL).

url.description: Where to read the full article. This is the article's real canonical URL — on media.20fit.id for republished content (to avoid duplicate-content SEO issues), or this site's own /articles/<slug> page for content that originates here.
